title: Gemini 3.8 Flash Officially Integrates with B.AI API, Focusing on Long-Term Programming and Autonomous Agents

content_html:
Google continues to accelerate its iteration in the field of artificial intelligence. On September 4, the B.AI platform officially announced the integration of the latest Gemini 3.8 Flash model API from Google DeepMind, marking the comprehensive deployment of this main model in the developer ecosystem.

As the latest generation of the Gemini 3 family, the Gemini 3.8 Flash perfectly balances the core advantages of high cost-effectiveness and low latency. In specific application scenarios, the model has achieved significant improvements in software engineering, complex agent tasks, professional domain multi-step reasoning, and industries with high professional barriers such as finance and law, providing developers with stronger underlying support.

In terms of core technical specifications, the Gemini 3.8 Flash fully supports a large context window of 1M Tokens and native multimodal input. Designed from the beginning, it is deeply optimized for complex logical reasoning and long-term agent workflows. With the official launch of this model on the B.AI API, it also provides the industry with a new computing power option for exploring longer-term and more autonomous AI application scenarios.
